data.name: Zoe
data.gender_notes: Zoe is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek zōē, 'life'. Its root is Greek zōē (ζωή). A New Testament Greek word for life (John 1:4). Zoe is a Greek name meaning “Life”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Zoe expresses “Life”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Zoe total 19, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
